scripts.dev:server: cd packages/server && php artisan serve || echo 'Server not started yet'
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:client && npm run setup:server
scripts.setup:server: cd packages/server && composer install || echo 'Composer not installed yet'
scripts.dev:backend: cd packages/backend && php artisan serve || echo 'Backend not started yet'
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: cd packages/backend && composer install || echo 'Composer not installed yet'
